title: Is a successful tour on-sale all in the timing?
summary: With touring calendars at every level filling up faster than ever, the timing of a major tour on-sale has become an increasingly important part of the touring equation. title: Hungary’s Ozora Festival closes early after pair of attendee deaths
summary: Hungary’s Ozora Festival shut down part way through proceedings as two attendees died at the event in unrelated incidents. title: FTC Live to build outdoor venue in Quito’s Parque Bicentenario
summary: Ecuadorian promoter Feel the Club (FTC Live) is to build a new semi-outdoor venue structure in the capital Quito, which is set to upgrade the concert capabilities of the city’s Parque Bicentenario. title: Massive Attack barred from Singapore after onstage display
summary: After breaching national law by displaying a Palestinian flag onstage, English outfit Massive Attack have been banned from returning to and performing in Singapore.
